fields.description: Save-image magic header, ASCII 'FINALFP' identifying a valid Final Fire Pro Wrestling management-mode save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804aabc compares 7 bytes with func_0x0806fb0c against the save-image header at file offset 0x0; samples/baseline.sav holds 46 49 4E 41 4C 46 50 ('FINALFP') there.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Wrestler record 0 status/flag byte (per-wrestler state flags; observed bits 0x01, 0x02, 0x80 across the 244-record roster).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804a240 writes record byte 0 (copied from roster-table byte at +0x1) for each of 244 records at save-buffer offset 0x6080+i*0x48; FUN_0804a32c iterates the same 244-entry roster table (source stride 0x1F8) reading per-wrestler flag bytes.
fields.name: wrestler_00_status

fields.description: Wrestler record 0 attribute/parameter block (5 high-entropy parameter bytes followed by per-record data copied from the roster table).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804a240 copies 0x12 bytes from roster-table offset +0x2 to save-buffer offset 0x6081+i*0x48 for 244 records at stride 0x48.
fields.name: wrestler_00_attributes

fields.description: Wrestler record 0 ring name in Shift-JIS (katakana), e.g. record 0 reads as a katakana ring name in baseline.sav.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804a240 copies 0x14 bytes from roster-table offset +0x14 to save-buffer offset 0x6093+i*0x48; baseline.sav record 0 holds Shift-JIS katakana at 0x6093..0x60A6.
fields.name: wrestler_00_ring_name

fields.description: Wrestler record 0 real name in Shift-JIS (kanji/kana).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804a240 copies 0x1E bytes from roster-table offset +0x28 to save-buffer offset 0x60A7+i*0x48; baseline.sav record 0 holds Shift-JIS kanji/kana at 0x60A7..0x60C4.
fields.name: wrestler_00_real_name

fields.description: Wrestler records 1..243, each 0x48 bytes with the same layout as record 0 (status byte, attribute block, ring name, real name).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804a240 serializes 244 records (loop counter 0xF3 down to 0, source stride 0x1F8, dest stride 0x48) at save-buffer offsets 0x6080..0xA51F; this field covers records 1..243 at 0x60C8..0xA51F.
fields.name: wrestler_records_01_243

fields.description: Stable/promotion name table: 18 entries of 0x2C bytes, each a pair of Shift-JIS strings (full name + short name).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804a240 first loop copies 0x18 + 0x10 bytes per entry for 0x12 (18) iterations at save-buffer stride 0x2C starting at offset 0xE9D4; baseline.sav holds 18 Shift-JIS name pairs at 0xE9D4..0xECEB.
fields.name: stable_names

fields.description: Per-wrestler affiliation/config byte for wrestler 0 (values 0x00..0x11 observed; entry 0 is 0x04).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804a32c copies one byte per wrestler for 244 iterations (source stride 0x1F8, the same roster-table stride used by FUN_0804a240) into a consecutive 244-byte buffer; baseline.sav holds 244 small per-wrestler values at 0xED2A..0xEE1B.
fields.name: wrestler_00_affiliation

fields.evidence: Same 244-byte buffer written by FUN_0804a32c as wrestler_00_affiliation; entries 1..243 at 0xED2B..0xEE1B.
fields.name: wrestler_affiliation_rest

fields.description: Save generation counter used to select the newest sector image on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804ab88 reads a u32 counter at save-buffer offset +iRam0804abec from each candidate sector image and keeps the image with the highest value; baseline.sav holds 1 at 0xEE4C directly before the stored checksums, inside the verified checksum coverage.
fields.name: save_counter

fields.description: Stored 32-bit byte-sum checksum over save bytes [0x0, 0xEE50).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804aaf0 stores the 32-bit byte-sum over save-buffer [0x0, 0xEE50) at offset 0xEE50 and FUN_0804ab34 verifies it; independently recomputed sum over samples/baseline.sav bytes [0, 61008) equals the stored LE u32 0x000DAF89.
fields.name: checksum_sum32

fields.description: Stored 32-bit rotating-xor checksum over save bytes [0x0, 0xEE50): per byte x = ((x ^ byte) << 1), mod 2^32.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804aaf0 stores the rotating-xor chain over save-buffer [0x0, 0xEE50) at offset 0xEE54 and FUN_0804ab34 verifies it; independently recomputed value over samples/baseline.sav equals the stored LE u32 0x00000010.
fields.name: checksum_xor32
